title: Microsoft Word: choose the model used by Copilot Agent Mode on the web
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap facts and Anthropic access control are supported, and no documentation found establishes the default or controls for this specific Word capability. The cost discussion should distinguish its remaining feature-specific uncertainty from Microsoft's published general rules for model selection and usage-based billing.
